interactions.description: accept HOBO-565 representative accessibility and usability check fixture

quickstartFixtureRefs.representativeUse: onboarding evidence reuses accepted object-graph labels and first-run step order
plan review evidence reuses accepted plan preview proof-mode and refusal wording
dashboard evidence reuses projection fixture ids for topology and stale-state checks
marketplace install intent can cite accepted deploy evidence without building install runtime
docs and troubleshooting evidence reuse stale-evidence copy and owner routing
support handoff evidence can cite recovery fixture without promising production restore
publisher review evidence reuses manifest collection fixture names for uploaded proof records
launch demo evidence keeps scope-out labels visible before launch claims are allowed

checkDefinitions.label: Keyboard path
checkDefinitions.proves: Primary artifact steps are reachable, ordered, and operable without pointer input.

checkDefinitions.label: Screen-reader smoke
checkDefinitions.proves: Representative labels, landmarks, state, owner, and next action are announced.

checkDefinitions.label: Responsive layout
checkDefinitions.proves: Required text, controls, and status fields remain visible without overlap.

checkDefinitions.label: Contrast threshold
checkDefinitions.proves: Text, state, focus, and severity affordances meet launch baseline or carry limitation evidence.

checkDefinitions.label: Reduced motion
checkDefinitions.proves: Motion-heavy transitions expose a reduced-motion posture and preserve status meaning.

checkDefinitions.label: State clarity
checkDefinitions.proves: Happy, blocked, stale, unknown, and scope-out states explain owner and next action.

checkDefinitions.label: Copy clarity
checkDefinitions.proves: Artifact copy is customer-safe, support-routable, and does not overstate readiness.

scenarios.safeOutcome: artifact can be treated as branch evidence for the named fixture only
route blocker to owner without waiving launch gates or inventing runtime behavior
mark evidence stale or unknown instead of using it as launch-ready proof
handoff redacted evidence to the named owner without customer-data exposure
make accessibility disposition explicit before customer-ready claims
keep live, simulated, reference fixture, and scope-out evidence separate

scopeOut: No full accessibility audit or certification.
No automated accessibility test suite buildout.
No customer data or customer screenshots.
No launch claims without named evidence.
